title: The 21 Best REI Holiday Sale Outdoor Deals
gist: A WIRED shopping roundup of REI's 2026 Holiday Sale (Nov 13–23) plus concurrent deals at Backcountry and cottage brands; mostly product listings, with light signal on promo structure and REI's private-label 90%-for-70% value strategy.

insights.claim: REI's 2026 Holiday Sale runs November 13 to November 23, and REI Members can use code HOLIDAY2026 for an extra 20 percent off one full-price item and one REI Outlet item.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Member-gated extra discounts show REI using its co-op membership as a holiday traffic and loyalty lever.
insights.quote: REI Members can use the code HOLIDAY2026 to save an extra 20 percent off one full-price item

insights.claim: Competing outdoor retailers and cottage brands, including Backcountry.com, Six Moon Designs and Zenbivy, are running concurrent holiday sales, with Six Moon Designs offering 25% off via code YULEHIKE.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Broad simultaneous discounting across outdoor retail signals a promotional, margin-pressured holiday season for the category.
insights.locator: There are also sales at Backcountry.com

insights.claim: Discounts on premium outdoor gear in the roundup are steep, e.g., Big Agnes Copper Spur UL1 Bikepack tent $150 off to $350, Sea To Summit Spark 15F bag $137 off to $412, and Mountain Hardwear Ghost Whisperer jacket $105 off to $245.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Roughly 25-30% markdowns on flagship ultralight items suggest inventory clearing among outdoor brands.
insights.locator: Big Agnes Copper Spur UL1 Bikepack Tent

insights.claim: REI's house-brand strategy, per WIRED's reviewer, is to deliver about 90 percent of a designer item for 70 percent of the price, which he says has produced great, affordable gear such as the Flexlite Air Chair and Flash 22 pack.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Private-label value positioning supports REI margins and share against premium brands like Nemo in a price-sensitive market.
insights.quote: you get 90 percent of the designer item for 70 percent of the price
insights.locator: The thing to keep in mind when you shop REI
